title: AI for Indian construction
summary: Find the single best AI-led business for India's construction sector: a painful, paperwork- or labour-heavy workflow where a small team can win paying customers within 12 months.
use_case: Open: any workflow across bidding, site execution, billing, compliance or financing
geography: India, starting with Tier 1 and Tier 2 cities
buyer: Contractors, mid-size developers or lenders (to be decided by research)
user: Site engineers, project managers, billing and compliance staff
constraints: Small founding team, no hardware manufacturing
Must sell in under 6 months per customer
Interfaces in English, Hindi and at least one regional language
goal: One idea with evidence of willingness to pay and a test that can run in 4 weeks
